_method: Method: every Reel was downloaded without signing in (yt-dlp), sampled at one frame per second into contact sheets, and transcribed locally with Whisper (Hebrew, first 90 seconds; the first 18 transcripts with beam search, the rest with greedy decoding to save time). Sonnet agents coded each Reel from all of its frames, transcript, caption and counts with one brief (`src/CODING_BRIEF.md`). I then checked every included Reel myself against its frames: all frames for the eight deep dives, a 10-frame strip plus the coding for the rest (`inspected` says which).
